user.title: Dashboard Studio
user.description: Adds the wall-tablet dashboard at /hadash/index.html and the Dashboard Studio to the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Dashboard Studio is already set up.

show_note.name: Show a note on the wall
show_note.description: Shows a short note on every Dashboard Studio tablet. It can go away by itself when its reason ends.

message.name: Message
message.description: The words on the note, such as "The garage is still open".

title.name: Title
title.description: A small word above the message, such as "Garage". Leave it empty for "Home".

id.name: ID
id.description: A name for the note, so a later action can change it or take it away.

until_entity.name: Until this device
until_entity.description: The note goes away when this device reaches the state below, or changes when no state is given.

until_state.name: Until this state
until_state.description: For example closed, locked or off.

minutes.name: For minutes
minutes.description: The note goes away after this many minutes.

clear_note.name: Take a note away
clear_note.description: Takes a note away from every tablet.

id.name: ID
id.description: The ID given in Show a note on the wall.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on for a while
turn_on_for.description: Turns a device on, and Home Assistant turns it off after the minutes. Turning it off by hand ends the time.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: A switch, fan, light, valve or humidifier.
